Rajinikanth's 'Jailer 2' Earns Over ₹125 Crore Worldwide on Day 1

Rajinikanth's film 'Jailer 2' has reportedly earned ₹125.25 crore worldwide on its first day of release. The movie, released in five languages, grossed ₹59.70 crore in India on Friday. Reports indicate the film broke several records on its opening day, with some outlets describing it as a "dhamakedaar action-packed" film with "tremendous twists" that will "make the heart happy."
